reviews.review: Disappointing and very unlikely that I will finish it.  To be fair, there seems to be a decent story in the game, but too many other little issues just ruined the experience.  The UI, even after all this time, is tedious.  To view a quest you need to dig down through multiple sub-folders.  You can hit a key to get to the map, but to return you can't hit the same key, you have to exit out of the map to the main menu, then exit out of that to return to the game.  The whole thing felt like a bad console port.  AI of companions during battle was questionable at best, as even when you give them orders to go to a location they would sometimes run around out of cover and get knocked out.  And I didn't get this game until 2025 (luckily on sale), figuring issues like this would have been resolved by now.  In short, if you want to get it I recommend getting on sale (at least I didn't feel completely ripped off).

In the original trilogy or legendary edition, if you press space you either run, take cover or activate things. Also if you hold shift the command overlay pops up. Here you can change your teammates or your own weapons, or activate powers or ammo powers (such as warp ammo). On Mass Effect Andromeda, space makes you jump like a cork out of a champagne bottle and shift does nothing. Also it felt like they took ME races, weapons and powers and dumped them in some exploring game and then slapped "Mass Effect" on it. The graphics are poorer than Mass Effect 2 (OT) but better than 1 (OT). All in all a bad entry and a let down.

I never understood all the hate this game received. Sure the character models are pretty wooden and hilarious at times but I really enjoyed all the different story arcs, places to explore and new ways to kill your enemies! This is a very fun game. It took me about 10 hours until I was thoroughly hooked and this review comes after I bought it again on steam so total I have about 450 hours. The crafting system kind of gives me a headache but having so many ways to enjoy this game you can easily have multiple playthroughs  before you start to get bored of things.
